company_name: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. Common Shares
title: Plomosas
summary: Plomosas is a permitted, advanced exploration-stage silver project in Sinaloa, Mexico, owned and operated by GR Silver.
body_markdown:
Plomosas is a permitted, advanced exploration-stage silver project in Sinaloa, Mexico, owned and operated by GR Silver. After assuming ownership of the project from First Majestic, GR Silver announced an updated resource estimate at Plomosas and began an infill drill program to incorporate new zones into the resource model.


As reported by GR Silver, significant results from the infill drilling program at Plomosas include 518 g/t AgEq over 44.5 metres, 1,146 g/t AgEq over 12.5 metres and 471 g/t AgEq over 24.9 metres. GR expects Plomosas mine and pilot plant restart to be a key H1 2026 catalyst, with engineering completion, bulk sample test mining, a resource update and a PEA outlined as 2026 milestones.


Metalla holds a 2% NSR royalty on Plomosas, subject to a 1% buyback for $1 million.
